title.source: El velo de Águeda y la colada del Etna
title.text: Agatha's veil and the lava flow of Etna

details.source: La tradición relata que, al año siguiente del martirio, los habitantes de Catania llevaron el velo de Águeda ante la lava y atribuyeron a su intercesión que esta se detuviera. Se registra como narración hagiográfica y memoria local. Fuente consultada: https://www.vaticanstate.va/en/state-and-government/general-informations/saint-of-the-day/1502-5-february-saint-agatha-martyr.html. Aprobado para publicación editorial; esta ficha no afirma una validación científica ni un decreto eclesiástico de reconocimiento del suceso.
details.text: Tradition recounts that, in the year after the martyrdom, the inhabitants of Catania carried Agatha's veil before the lava and attributed its stopping to her intercession. It is recorded as a hagiographic narrative and local memory. Source consulted: https://www.vaticanstate.va/en/state-and-government/general-informations/saint-of-the-day/1502-5-february-saint-agatha-martyr.html. Approved for editorial publication; this entry does not claim scientific validation or an ecclesiastical decree recognizing the event.
